name: Buffalo All Access
note: Service centered on Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus district and surrounding neighborhoods; open to general public. Service zone is a subset of city limits

name: CDTA FLEX+
note: Microtransit zone covering downtown Albany core and Amtrak station connections; actual service area may be subset of city limits

name: Centro MOVE
note: Single microtransit zone in Rome launched March 2024; possible future Syracuse zone expansion reported in Nov 2025 but not yet confirmed as launched

name: Circuit Brentwood
note: Brentwood hamlet service area including Hauppauge Industrial Area and Suffolk County Community College connections

name: Circuit East Hampton
note: East Hampton village (technically town) covering LIRR station, Main Street, and beach area; overlaps with Suffolk Transit On-Demand East Hampton zone but separate operator

name: Circuit Montauk
note: Circuit's own site (ridecircuit.com/montauk) and search of local coverage give no stated zone size, radius, or boundary streets - only destination landmarks (Bayfront Park, The Plaza, Jitney stop, beachside hotels), all in the small downtown core of the Montauk CDP. Full Montauk CDP (~51 km2, including Montauk Point park land) is used as the containing unit but is understood to substantially overstate the actual service area, which is limited to the built-up downtown/beachfront core.

name: Circuit New Rochelle (CircuitNR)
note: Service includes downtown core plus expanded southern/eastern zones; exact zone boundaries not specified

name: Circuit Rockaways (Rockaway Rides)
note: Rockaway Peninsula microtransit zone; neighborhood-based service with no fixed administrative boundary. Service area spans Far Rockaway LIRR corridor and beach areas

name: Circuit Southampton
note: Southampton village (technically town); overlaps geographically with Suffolk Transit On-Demand Southampton zone but separate operator and pricing model (free flag-down vs. paid app)

name: Franklin County Public Transportation (Southern Zone Demand-Response)
note: Demand-response 'Southern Zone' service operates curb-to-curb within Saranac Lake and Tupper Lake (county site: 'bus service is provided within Saranac Lake, Tupper Lake and into Lake Placid'); no zone-size or full-county coverage stated, so encoded as the two named villages rather than the whole county. Source: http://www.franklincountyny.gov/departments/transportation/index.php

name: Move Sullivan
note: County-wide service confirmed per operator page; Highland and Delaware routes specifically mentioned

name: NICE Mini
note: Two service zones: South Shore (Merrick-Lynbrook corridor) and Syosset cluster; additional zones planned

name: Putnam On-Demand
note: County-wide service as confirmed by operator page; replaced former PART Route 3

name: RTS On Demand
note: Seven-county Rochester region; 7 zones phased in starting early 2025, each zone connecting to RTS Connect bus stops

name: Suffolk Transit On-Demand
note: Two zones each covering multiple hamlets across a full NY town, not just incorporated villages: Southampton zone spans Southampton, North Sea, North Haven and Sag Harbor (Town of Southampton); East Hampton zone spans Montauk, East Hampton, Springs and Amagansett (Town of East Hampton), per sctbus.org/On-Demand zone descriptions. Encoded as the two containing towns (approximate) since actual coverage is a multi-hamlet subset of each town, not the whole town.
